name: ContactPointsEditor
tagline: The Contact Points Editor keeps every way to reach a person or organisation in one place: mobile and office numbers, email addresses, WhatsApp, website and LinkedIn.
description: The Contact Points Editor keeps every way to reach a person or organisation in one place: mobile and office numbers, email addresses, WhatsApp, website and LinkedIn. Each entry can have a label, one entry of each type is the primary, and any entry can be marked Do not contact. You can also choose the person's preferred channel.
features: Website and LinkedIn entries with labels
One primary per type, do-not-contact flags, preferred channel
Phone-number normalising with a default country code
Privacy masking and a phone card layout
